title: 第15章 天生剑胎第16章 徒弟我来啦
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
小巷里，一个七八岁的小男孩，正被其他几个看着有十岁的男孩揍。
小男孩一身破破烂烂的，眼神凶狠地瞪着那几个欺负自己的大男孩。
龇牙咧嘴的发出动静，企图把这些欺负自己的人给吓退。
但年龄是硬伤，人数也比不过。
尽管他拼尽全力的保护自己，但还是被打得遍体鳞伤。
“居然还敢瞪我们，你这个臭乞丐，找打呢！”
“住手！”
寂琳看不下去了，直接冲了过去。
叶无忧也没有想拦着，因为看到那个小男孩，她仿佛看到了曾经的自己。
“小丫头，你想给这个小乞丐出头啊？”为首的大男孩一脸戏谑的看着寂琳。
一个六岁的小丫头和一个看着不怎么大的少女，并没有什么威胁。
“你们欺负一个比你们小的人算什么本事？有本事跟我来比划比划啊！”寂琳也是有些飘飘然，她居然敢对这么多大男孩说这么嚣张的话。
不出所料，对面几个大男孩哈哈大笑，纷纷嘲笑她的自不量力。
“臭丫头，滚一边去，要不然我们连你也打！”
寂琳冷哼一声，手中一把透明的水刀飞射过去，直接从对方的脸颊上擦过。
“再不跑的话，下次对准的就是你的脖子！”
这几个大男孩虽然嚣张，但也只是对普通人嚣张，可不敢对修士有半点念头。
见状只能灰溜溜的跑了。
叶无忧无奈的摇了摇头，以前她也盼望着有一个人能将自己救之于水火，不过现在的她，终于等到了。

“喂，你还好吗？”
寂琳走过去，在小男孩的身边蹲下。
实际上，对方看起来应该可以当她哥哥。
小男孩摇了摇头。
寂琳拿出帕子，凝聚一个小水团后将帕子沾湿，递了过去。
“擦擦吧。”
小男孩有些犹豫，毕竟这帕子看起来很干净，而他的手很脏。
“师父说，保持干净卫生，可以有效地预防生病。拿着吧，我还有很多帕子。”
小男孩点点头，将帕子接了过来，开始仔仔细细地擦脸，擦手，直到露出那张乖巧的脸，那条帕子也变得乌漆墨黑。
他看着黑乎乎的帕子，羞红了脸。
“对不起。”他嗫嚅地吐出三个字。
寂琳摇了摇头，说：“没事，一条帕子而已。你有没有事？有没有哪里受伤？”
他一直低着头，不说话，也有可能不知道该说什么。
叶无忧靠在一旁的墙壁上，饶有趣味地看着他们两个小孩子互动。
“这个给你，这个丹药能帮你恢复伤势。”寂琳拿出一颗丹药递了过去。
她人小，还不知道这颗丹药的珍贵，等到以后才会明白，师父炼的丹药还真是绝世无双。
小男孩鼓起勇气，扯开嗓子问道：“可不可以，可不可以让我跟着你师父？我也想修仙。”
“啊？”
寂琳愣住了。
修仙这种事情，是师父告诉她有灵根，她才走上这条路的。（其实是求很久才拜的师。）

叶无忧能修炼，也是因为她本身就有灵根，只不过筋脉闭塞导致无法修炼。
但是眼前的小男孩什么情况，她一概不知。

In the alley, a seven or eight-year-old boy was being beaten by several other boys who looked to be ten years old.
The little boy was dressed in rags and stared fiercely at the older boys who bullied him.
He bared his teeth and made noises, trying to scare away these bullies.
But age is a drawback, and the number of people can't compare.
Although he tried his best to protect himself, he was still beaten black and blue.
"How dare you stare at us, you stinky beggar, you're looking for a beating!"
"Stop!"
Ji Lin couldn't stand it anymore and rushed over.
Ye Wuyou didn't want to stop him, because when she saw the little boy, she seemed to see her former self.
"Little girl, do you want to stand up for this little beggar?" The big boy at the head looked at Ji Lin with a playful expression.
A six-year-old girl and a girl who didn't look very old were not threatening.
"What's your ability to bully someone younger than you? If you have the ability, come and compete with me!" Ji Lin was also a little confused. She actually dared to say such arrogant words to so many big boys.
As expected, several big boys across from her laughed loudly and laughed at her overestimation.
"Stinky girl, get out of here, or we'll beat you too!"
Ji Lin snorted coldly, and shot a transparent water knife in her hand, directly grazing the opponent's cheek.
"If you don't run away, I'll target your neck next time!"
Although these big boys are arrogant, they are only arrogant towards ordinary people and do not dare to have the slightest thought towards monks.
Seeing this, he could only run away in despair.
Ye Wuyou shook her head helplessly. She used to hope that someone could save her from danger, but now she finally waited.
"Hey, are you okay?"
Jilin walked over and squatted down next to the little boy.
In fact, he looks like he could be her brother.
The little boy shook his head.
Ji Lin took out the handkerchief, gathered a small ball of water, wetted the handkerchief, and handed it over.
"Just wipe it."
The little boy hesitated. After all, the veil looked clean, but his hands were dirty.
"Master said that keeping clean and hygienic can effectively prevent illness. Take it, I still have many veils."
The little boy nodded, took the handkerchief, and began to wipe his face and hands carefully until his cute face was revealed and the handkerchief became pitch black.
He looked at the dark veil and blushed.
"I'm sorry." He murmured three words.
Ji Lin shook her head and said, "It's okay, it's just a veil. Are you okay? Are you injured anywhere?"
He kept his head down and didn't speak. He probably didn't know what to say.
Ye Wuyou leaned against the wall nearby, watching the two children interact with interest.
"Here you go, this pill can help you recover from your injuries." Ji Lin took out a pill and handed it over.
She was young and didn't know how precious this elixir was. Only later would she understand that the elixir prepared by her master was truly unparalleled.
The little boy plucked up the courage and asked at the top of his voice: "Can you, can you let me follow your master? I also want to become an immortal."
"Huh?"
Ji Lin was stunned.
For things like cultivating immortals, her master told her that she had spiritual roots, so she embarked on this path. (Actually, this is a teacher I have been seeking for a long time.)
Ye Wuyou can practice because she has spiritual roots, but her muscles and veins are blocked, which makes her unable to practice.
But she had no idea what was going on with the little boy in front of her.
